note: Letcher County campground in Little Laurel Park, on a hillside above 45-acre Fish Pond Lake about a mile west of Payne Gap near Jenkins. Wooden decks at the back of the sites look toward the lake through trees; there is no water access from the campground itself. A single restroom; dump station for an extra charge. The paved road around the lake suits walking and biking, the lake takes only electric motors and paddles, and ATV trails start near the head of the lake. --Claude
summary: Kept (local, no price gate). Operator Letcher County Tourism; 15 gravel back-in RV slips 22 x 56 ft at $25/night for up to 6, booked on the county's FlyBook; water + electric, no sewer (stored sewer true -> false); single restroom, no showers, dump; season 03-01..10-31 (county). Not waterfront kept. ATV-trail access flagged.

ATV trails' with 'different ATV access points' around the lake, and a 2020 camper report notes 'access to an ATV trail at the head of the lake' with a large ATV-trailer parking area near the trailhead. The campground is sold as a lakeside county RV park, not as a trail staging camp. Flagged for the reviewer, not a drop.
